local Device Service has 36 profiles including cores3, sticks3, cardputer-adv and paperdiy, but this PR builds, flashes and runs no firmware, so a virtual device would have nothing to measure; not a missing-profile case
the 5 skipped node tests need an M5Unified checkout; the same 5 are skipped on base, so the A/B comparison is unaffected

notes: PR left OPEN; exactly one English comment posted; no close, no push, no change to m5stack/M5GFX.
Evidence class is host-level test plus code-level verification; hardware and virtual-device validation are NOT RUN because the change has no runtime path.

Non-blocking wording notes: the PR description says targets.json records exceptions only, but boards registered with a non-construct_displayless constructor still need nonempty wiring_fields; and generated declarations keep targets.json entry order before falling back to catalog ID order.
